description: The file defines the EmployeeTerminationService class, which provides methods to access employee termination data, such as termination reasons, in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It implements data normalization and interacts with the EmployeeTerminationDao data access object.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationService
classes.description: Service class handling employee termination related operations, including fetching and normalizing termination reasons.

methods.name: getEmployeeTerminationDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeTerminationDao instance used for database operations related to employee termination.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonsArray
methods.description: Retrieves the list of termination reasons from the DAO and returns a normalized array suitable for use in other parts of the application.
